scope: Theorem 3.1 (Sector cost at fixed geometry) of the manuscript “The Critical Spin Field of the Planar XY Model” (preprints/The-Critical-Spin-Field-of-the-Planar-XY-Model-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 216 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 486481fbcc54fe62), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 13. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the domain and periods just specified, at b = bc and a = 8π, lim n→∞ Fs U,n = exp{−M(U)/(2a)}, M(U) = inf g∈H1(U) Z U |dv0 + dg|2 . (3) The limit holds along every admissible mesh-rounding sequence. The variational energy depends only on the periods.
